description: This file defines a React component named SearchForm that provides a user interface for performing search operations. It includes input fields for query keywords, language selection, and minimum star count, along with submit and reset buttons. The component manages internal state and user interactions, and communicates user input back to parent components via callbacks.

methods.name: parseNumberSafe
methods.description: Safely parses a string into a non-negative number or returns an empty string if invalid.
